Strategy selector

Add curves to the plots: a box (a strategy on one representation) at its opening hashing cell, a single cell, or a single variant, each in the convention, mode and encoder choice set below. Every added curve keeps its own colour and marker and is drawn on both samples where it was measured, Run 3 on the left and HL-LHC on the right. Each strategy family has one colour, its variants shades of it, the same whenever and in whatever order a curve is added. Each curve brings its own standard trigger (black) and supervised classifier (grey dashed) in its own convention, mode and footing. Every number carries its statistical error, its block and the effective number of background crossings behind the cut.

Numbers for the curves shown

Rows are the samples and the budget rungs, columns the curves shown. Capture is the share of never-trained signal (the mean over 19 families) the trigger keeps, in percent, with its statistical error: the binomial error on the signal probes and the uncertainty of the cut from the background tail. The spread over encoder trainings or plane draws is printed beside it, never inside. keff is the effective number of background crossings above the cut. H to aa to 4b is shown apart, never in the mean.
